title: This AI Agent Can Search the ENTIRE Internet 🤯  #ai #chatgpt #aitutorial #coding
description:
🤯 AI agents are powerful… but what happens when they need to search the real internet?

In this video, I showcase Agent Reach, a tool designed to give AI agents access to information across platforms like Reddit, X, Instagram, YouTube, GitHub, LinkedIn and more.

Instead of relying on a single search engine or limited web access, Agent Reach can help AI agents reach information across multiple platforms and use that data for research and automation.
